entry.title: New: Bill 101, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES AND DEPARTMENT OF POLICE, TECHNICAL AND SUPPORT SERVICES PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to increase Carryover/Savings in the General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $1,300,000 and by increasing the Department of Police, Technical and Support Services Program, and Total Appropriations (Operating and Capital Improvement Projects) by $1,300,000.
